_note: Experiment 1 pilot configuration (created during the Apart AI x Epistemics sprint, Nov 2026). Nothing here authorises paid runs: run_pilot.py also requires --allow-paid and a --cap-usd.

anthropic_api._fallbacks_note: Off on purpose: a refusal-triggered fallback silently swaps the model under test. Refusals are logged as failed runs instead.

claude_code._note: Runs `claude -p --bare` inside a sandbox-exec profile with a throwaway HOME, so no user CLAUDE.md, memory, keychain or repo files are visible. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

pricing_usd_per_mtok._source: Anthropic first-party list prices as cached in the claude-api skill (2026-10-06). cache_write_5m is assumed at 1.25x input and Haiku cache_read at 0.1x input (not listed there). Re-checked 2026-11-14 against the skill's 2026-11-03 table: Sonnet 5.5 cache_read corrected 0.20 -> 0.10 (no Sonnet runs before this); Haiku 5.5 prices apply to prompts up to 100K tokens.
